stowage_categories.01: the material may be stowed “on deck” in closed cargo transport units or “under deck” on a cargo vessel (up to 12 passengers) or on a passenger vessel.
stowage_categories.02: the material may be stowed “on deck” in closed cargo transport units or “under deck” on a cargo vessel (up to 12 passengers) or “on deck” in closed cargo transport units or “under deck” in closed cargo transport units on a passenger vessel.
stowage_categories.03: the material may be stowed “on deck” in closed cargo transport units or “under deck” on a cargo vessel (up to 12 passengers) but the material is prohibited on a passenger vessel.
stowage_categories.04: the material may be stowed “on deck” in closed cargo transport units or “under deck” in closed cargo transports on a cargo vessel (up to 12 passengers) but the material is prohibited on a passenger vessel.
stowage_categories.05: the material may be stowed “on deck” in closed cargo transport units on a cargo vessel (up to 12 passengers) but the material is prohibited on a passenger vessel.
stowage_categories.A: the material may be stowed “on deck” or “under deck” on a cargo vessel or on a passenger vessel.
stowage_categories.B: (i) The material may be stowed “on deck” or “under deck” on a cargo vessel and on a passenger vessel carrying a number of passengers limited to not more than the larger of 25 passengers, or one passenger per each 3 m of overall vessel length; and (ii) “On deck only” on passenger vessels in which the number of passengers specified in paragraph (k)(2)(i) of this section is exceeded.
stowage_categories.C: the material must be stowed “on deck only” on a cargo vessel or on a passenger vessel.
stowage_categories.D: the material must be stowed “on deck only” on a cargo vessel or on a passenger vessel carrying a number of passengers limited to not more than the larger of 25 passengers or one passenger per each 3 m of overall vessel length, but the material is prohibited on a passenger vessel in which the limiting number of passengers is exceeded.
stowage_categories.E: the material may be stowed “on deck” or “under deck” on a cargo vessel or on a passenger vessel carrying a number of passengers limited to not more than the larger of 25 passengers, or one passenger per each 3 m of overall vessel length, but is prohibited from carriage on a passenger vessel in which the limiting number of passengers is exceeded.

stowage_codes.10: Glass bottles not permitted under deck.
stowage_codes.102: Stow “separated from” all odor absorbing cargoes.
stowage_codes.103: Only to be loaded under dry weather conditions.
stowage_codes.105: As approved by the Competent Authority of the country concerned.
stowage_codes.108: The transport temperature should be indicated on the tank.
stowage_codes.109: Label as a flammable liquid if flash point is 60 °C (140 °F) or below.
stowage_codes.11: Keep away from heat and open flame.
stowage_codes.110: Packaging Group II if concentration does not exceed 70 percent acid.
stowage_codes.111: If concentration exceeds 50 percent acid, notes 66, 74, 89, and 90 apply.
stowage_codes.112: Packaging Group II for concentrations not less that 50 percent and Packaging Group III for concentrations less than 50 percent.
stowage_codes.113: Packaging Group II if concentrations does not exceed 60 percent acid.
stowage_codes.114: Corrosive subsidiary risk label required unless concentration is less than 80 percent.
stowage_codes.115: If packaged in glass or earthenware inner packagings in wooden or fiberboard outer packagings, the maximum quantity on any vessel is 500 kg (equivalent to 450 L).
stowage_codes.116: In a cargo space capable of being opened up in an emergency. The possible need to open hatches in case of fire to provide maximum ventilation and to apply water in an emergency and the consequent risk to the stability of the ship through flooding of the cargo space should be considered before loading.
stowage_codes.117: In a clean cargo space capable of being opened up in an emergency. In the case of bagged fertilizer in freight containers, it is sufficient if in the case of an emergency, the cargo is accessible through free approaches (hatch entries) and mechanical ventilation enables the master to exhaust any gases or fumes resulting from decomposition. The possible need to open hatches in case of fire to provide maximum ventilation and to apply water in an emergency and the consequent risk to the stability of the ship through flooding of the cargo space should be considered before loading.
stowage_codes.118: Stowage—Category D, Category E freight containers and pallet boxes only. Ventilation may be required. The possible need to open hatches in a case of fire to provide maximum ventilation and to supply water in an emergency, and the consequent risk to the stability of the ship through flooding of the cargo space, should be considered before loading.
stowage_codes.12: Keep as cool as reasonably practicable.3
stowage_codes.120: Provide good surface and through ventilation.
stowage_codes.121: Packaging group III when the flash point of the flammable liquid is 23 °C (73 °F) or above.
stowage_codes.125: Segregation same as for flammable liquids, but also “away from” flammable solids.
stowage_codes.126: Segregation same as for Class 9, miscellaneous hazardous materials.
stowage_codes.127: For packages carrying a subsidiary risk of Class 1 (explosives), segregation same as for Class 1, Division 1.3.
stowage_codes.128: Stow in accordance with the IMDG Code, Sub-section 7.6.2.7.2 (incorporated by reference; see § 171.7 of this subchapter).
stowage_codes.129: Stowage Category A applies, except for uranyl nitrate hexahydrate solution for which Category D applies.
stowage_codes.13: Keep as dry as reasonably practicable.3
stowage_codes.130: Stowage Category A applies, except for uranyl nitrate hexahydrate solution, uranium metal hexahydrate solution, uranium metal pyrophoric and thorium metal pyrophoric for which Category D applies.
stowage_codes.131: Stowage Category A applies, except for uranyl nitrate hexahydrate solution, uranium metal pyrophoric and thorium metal pyrophoric for which Category D applies, and taking into account any supplementary requirements specified in the transport documents.
stowage_codes.132: Stowage A applies, taking into account any supplementary requirements specified in the transport documents.
stowage_codes.135: Stow “Separated from” mercury and mercury compounds.
stowage_codes.137: For arsenic sulphides, Stow “separated from” acids.
stowage_codes.14: For metal drums, stowage permitted under deck on cargo vessels.
stowage_codes.142: Packages in cargo transport units must be stowed so as to allow for adequate air circulation throughout the cargo.
stowage_codes.144: When stowed under deck, mechanical ventilation shall be in accordance with SOLAS, Chapter II-2/Regulation 19 (IBR, see § 171.7 of this subchapter) for flammable liquids with flashpoint below 23 °C (73 °F).
stowage_codes.145: Stow “separated from” ammonium compounds except for UN1444.
stowage_codes.146: Category B stowage applies for unit loads in open cargo transport units.
stowage_codes.147: Stow “separated from” flammable gases and flammable liquids.
stowage_codes.148: In addition: from flammable gases and flammable liquids when stowed on deck of a containership a minimum distance of two container spaces athwartship shall be maintained, when stowed on ro-ro ships a distance of 6 m athwartship shall be maintained.
stowage_codes.149: For engines or machinery containing fuels with flash point equal or greater than 23 °C (73.4 °F), stowage Category A.
stowage_codes.14E: On deck, cargo transport unit must be steel.
stowage_codes.15: May be stowed in portable magazine or metal locker.
stowage_codes.150: For uranium metal pyrophoric and thorium metal pyrophoric stowage, category D applies.
stowage_codes.152: Segregation as for Class 8. However, in relation to Class 7, no segregation needs to be applied.
stowage_codes.153: Stow “separated longitudinally by an intervening complete compartment or hold from” Divisions 1.1, 1.2, and 1.5.
stowage_codes.154: Notwithstanding the stowage category indicated in column 10A of the § 172.101 Table, may be stowed in accordance with the provisions of packing instruction US 1 in § 173.62.
stowage_codes.155: Avoid handling the package or keep handling to a minimum. Inform the appropriate public health authority or veterinary authority where persons or animals may have been exposed.
stowage_codes.156: For lithium batteries transported in accordance with § 173.185(f) or for purposes of disposal or recycling, stowage category C applies.
stowage_codes.157: For aerosols and gas receptacles transported for purposes of recycling or disposal, stowage category C applies, and stowage must be clear of living quarters.
stowage_codes.15E: On deck, cargo transport unit must be leakproof.
stowage_codes.16: No other cargo may be stowed in the same hold with this material.
stowage_codes.17: Segregation same as for flammable gases but “away from” dangerous when wet.
stowage_codes.18: Prohibited on any vessel carrying explosives (except explosives in Division 1.4, Compatibility group S).
stowage_codes.19E: “Separated from” explosives containing chlorates or perchlorates.
stowage_codes.21: Segregation same as for flammable liquids.
stowage_codes.21E: Cargo space ventilation must be carefully controlled to avoid excessive condensation.
stowage_codes.22: Segregation same as for flammable liquids if flash point is below 60 °C (140 °F).
stowage_codes.22E: “Separated from” ammonium compounds and explosives containing ammonium compounds or salts.
stowage_codes.23: Segregation same as for flammable liquids if flash point is between 23 °C (73 °F) and 60 °C (140 °F).
stowage_codes.23E: “Separated from” Division 1.4 and “separated longitudinally by an intervening complete compartment or hold from” Division 1.1, 1.2, 1.3, 1.5, and 1.6 except from explosives of compatibility group J.
stowage_codes.24: Segregation same as for flammable solids.
stowage_codes.26E: For closed cargo transport units, a non-metallic lining is required when not in effectively sealed, sift-proof packages.
stowage_codes.27E: For closed cargo transport units, a non-metallic lining is required.
stowage_codes.3: Do not stow with high explosives.
stowage_codes.30: Stow “away from” animal or vegetable oils.
stowage_codes.32: Stow “away from” copper, its alloys and its salts.
stowage_codes.36: Stow “away from” heavy metals and their compounds.
stowage_codes.4: Shall not be stowed together with combustible material in the same cargo transport unit.
stowage_codes.41: Stow “away from” mercury and its compounds.
stowage_codes.42: Stow “away from” nitric acids and perchloric acids not exceeding 50 percent acid by weight.
stowage_codes.5: Stow “Separated from” powdered metals and their compounds.
stowage_codes.54: Stow “separated from” animal or vegetable oils.
stowage_codes.5E: Stow “away from” lead and its compounds.
stowage_codes.60: Stow “separated from” chlorates, chlorites, hypochlorites, nitrites, perchlorates, permanganates, and metallic powders.
stowage_codes.76: Stow “separated by a complete compartment or hold from” organic peroxides.
stowage_codes.77: Stow “separated longitudinally by a complete compartment or hold from” explosives.
stowage_codes.78: Stow “separated longitudinally by an intervening complete compartment or hold from” explosives.
stowage_codes.79: The maximum net quantity in one package for this material shipped aboard a passenger vessel is limited to 22.7 kg (50 pounds).
stowage_codes.8: Glass carboys not permitted on passenger vessels.
stowage_codes.80: Toy torpedoes must not be packed with other special fireworks.
stowage_codes.81: Under deck stowage permitted only if an indicating substance such as chloropicrin has been added.
stowage_codes.82: Under deck stowage is permitted only if containing not more than 36 percent by weight of hydrazine.
stowage_codes.84: Under deck stowage must be in well-ventilated space.
stowage_codes.85: Under deck stowage must be in mechanically ventilated space.
stowage_codes.86: Stow “separated by a complete compartment or hold from” explosives Division 1.3.
stowage_codes.88: Stow “separated by a complete compartment or hold from” Class 1 (explosives) except Division 1.4.
stowage_codes.9: Glass carboys not permitted under deck.
stowage_codes.93: Stow not accessible to unauthorized persons on passenger vessels.
stowage_codes.94: Plastic jerricans and plastic drums not permitted under deck.
stowage_codes.96: Glass carboys not permitted under deck on passenger vessels.
stowage_codes.99: Only new metal drums permitted on passenger vessels.
